Similarly, Amiloride also binds to Scnn1g, which participates in the same type of activity, and thus contributes to Scnn1b's participation. These findings collectively indicate that Amiloride may modulate Scnn1b through a shared pathway involving ligand-gated sodium channels. The high scores in both paths suggest a strong, biologically plausible relationship, supported by the involvement of similar molecular mechanisms.
